system.description:
Favoured weapon: Dagger

Granted power: Once/day: reroll one of your own d20 rolls; from 6th this is Heaven's Answer's reroll at no cost. Advantage on all Knowledge and Lore checks. From 9th, twice a day in all, in either form.

Allegiance: Neutral Good, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Mystra in the World of Arneyan wiki.

Suggested vow: seal away one reckless or dangerous magic (your god's Paladin oath on the wiki; the vow you swear is yours to choose).
